explanation.text: The regulator produces a protein that controls transcription, whereas the structural genes encode proteins with metabolic or transport roles. Lactose permease acts at the membrane; β-galactosidase acts on lactose after uptake.

stem.text: Insulin can be produced as a recombinant human protein using genetically engineered Escherichia coli bacteria. Recombinant insulin can be used to treat type 1 diabetes.
Describe the advantages of using recombinant insulin, instead of insulin from animal sources, to treat type 1 diabetes.

explanation.text: A recombinant product can match the human amino acid sequence, reducing recognition as a foreign antigen. Microbial cultures can also be expanded under controlled conditions, so supply is less dependent on slaughtering animals.

reasoningChain: Separate benefits of the protein sequence from benefits of its production.
